DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お預り品のご確認ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to check an item you've left with us?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この票に袖の染みとあります。洗った後も残ったという意味か、預けた時の記録か知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 票の袖の染みが受付時か仕上がり結果か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: This slip says ‘stain on sleeve.’ I'd like to know whether that means it remained after cleaning or is a record from when I dropped it off.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the sleeve-stain note on the slip describes the initial condition or the cleaning result. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは受付時に伺った状態のメモです。仕上がりの結果欄ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is a note of the condition you told us about at drop-off. It isn't the cleaning-results field.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 受付のときに袖の染みを伝えたので、そのメモなんですね。仕上がりの状態も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受付時の染み記録と理解し仕上がりも知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I mentioned the sleeve stain when I dropped it off, so that's what the note is. I'd also like to know its finished condition.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand that the stain note records the initial condition and ask about the finished result too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お品物は、まだ受け取っていらっしゃいませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: You haven't collected the item yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ受け取っていません。受け取りのときに、袖を一緒に見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未受取と答え受取時に袖を一緒に確認してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. When I collect it, could you check the sleeve with me?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have not collected it and ask them to check the sleeve together at collection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受取時に、票とお品物を対応させてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: At collection, we'll match the slip with your item and explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。上着のほかにズボンも預けていますが、染みの相談は上着だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二点預けたうち上着だけが染み相談の対象と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I left trousers as well as a jacket, but my question about the stain concerns only the jacket.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that only the jacket, among two items left for cleaning, is the subject of the stain inquiry. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この票の上着一着についての確認ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: So you're asking about the one jacket on this slip?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、上着一着です。この票を持って受け取りに来ます。仕上がりについてもそのとき教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 対象を確認し票を持参して受取時に仕上がり説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, the one jacket. I'll bring this slip when I come to collect it. Please explain the finished result then too.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the item, say you will bring the slip, and request an explanation of the result at collection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。受取時に上着と記録を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let's check the jacket and record when you collect it.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: タクシーのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about a taxi?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: さっき降りてから手提げ袋がないと気付きました。車内へ置いたかはまだ確かではありませんが、忘れ物を照会したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 降車後に袋がなく車内置忘れ未確定で照会したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: After getting out just now, I noticed my carrier bag was missing. I'm not sure yet whether I left it in the car, but I'd like to make a lost-property inquiry.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your bag is missing after getting out and you want to inquire without claiming it was definitely left in the taxi. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 乗った車の番号や、領収書は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know the vehicle number or have a receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 車の番号は見ていません。領収書はあります。二時ごろ駅前から乗り、この建物の前で降りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 車番号不明でも時刻乗降場所領収書を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I didn't check the vehicle number. I have the receipt. I got in outside the station around two and got out in front of this building.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Provide the time, boarding and drop-off locations, and receipt even though you do not know the vehicle number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 領収書の運行者の案内を見て、乗車の記録と荷物の特徴を伝えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the operator information on the receipt and give them the trip details and a description of the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 灰色の布の袋で、中には作業着があります。大きさはこのくらいです。特徴も連絡先へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 袋の色素材中身と大きさを説明し照会先へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's a gray cloth bag with work clothes inside. It's about this big. I'll tell the inquiry contact these details too.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the bag's color, material, contents, and size and say you will give the inquiry contact this information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 連絡先は、この領収書で確認してください。ほかに立ち寄った場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the contact details on this receipt. Did you stop anywhere else?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 降りてから、この建物の受付へ行きました。受付にも袋がないか聞いてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 降車後の立寄り場所を答え受付にも確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: After getting out, I went to this building's reception. I'll ask reception whether the bag is there too.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State where you went after getting out and say you will check reception too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 見つかった場合の受取方法も、連絡先で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also ask that contact how to collect it if it's found.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 領収書を残して、乗った時刻と場所、袋の特徴を伝えます。見つかったら、どこで受け取れるかも聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 領収書と乗車情報で照会し発見時の受取場所も尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll keep the receipt and explain when and where I rode and what the bag looks like. If it's found, I'll also ask where I can collect it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Inquire with the receipt and trip details, and ask where to collect the bag if found. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容で照会されてください。領収書はお手元に残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please make your inquiry with those details. Keep the receipt with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 料金について、どの点を確認されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to check about the charge?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 新しい家に通知が来ました。払った控えがあるので済んだと思いましたが、控えの住所は前の家でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 新居通知に対し旧居住所の控えで支払済みと思ったと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: A notice came to my new home. I thought I'd paid because I had a payment receipt, but the address on that receipt was my old home.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you assumed the new-home notice had been paid based on a receipt bearing your old address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通知と控えは、今お持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the notice and receipt with you now?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、こちらです。通知は新居で、控えは旧居です。契約番号も違っていました。二つを見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 住所と契約番号が異なる二資料を示し確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, here they are. The notice is for my new home, and the receipt is for my old home. The contract numbers were different too. Could you look at both?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the two documents with different addresses and contract numbers and ask them to check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それぞれの契約と対象期間を担当へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the respective contracts and billing periods with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。旧居の方も引越し後にまだ請求があるのか知りたいので、両方の期間を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 旧居の引越し後の請求も含め二契約の対象期間を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please. I'd like to know whether my old home is still being billed after the move too, so I'd like to check both periods.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about the billing periods of both contracts, including any old-home charges after moving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お引越しの日も、担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell the person in charge your moving date too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 引越しは先月二十日です。旧居の使用を止める連絡もしたつもりですが、控えを家で探してみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 引越し日を伝え停止連絡の控えを家で探すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I moved on the twentieth of last month. I think I also notified them to stop service at the old home, but I'll look for the confirmation at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give your moving date and say you will look for the service-stop confirmation at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 新居の通知を払った記録は、ほかにありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you have any other record showing that the new-home notice was paid?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 新居の支払記録は見つかりませんでした。通知と旧居の控えをお見せします。家で探す物も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新居の支払記録は未発見と伝え照合と追加で探す資料の案内を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I haven't found a payment record for the new home. I'll show you the notice and old-home receipt. Please also tell me what else to look for at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say the new-home payment record has not been found and request comparison and guidance on additional documents to find. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。二つの契約を分けて担当へおつなぎします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll refer you to the person in charge with the two contracts kept separate.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご注文の列は、こちらからです。

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 器が積んである方へ行こうとしましたが、返却口と書いてありました。自分で一つ取る場所ではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 返却口の器を注文用に取る場所か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was about to go toward the stacked bowls, but it said ‘returns.’ So that isn't somewhere to take a bowl for myself, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check whether the bowls at the return counter are for taking when ordering. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そちらは食後の返却口です。ご注文は、この入口からお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: That's the return counter for after your meal. Please enter here to order.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ器には触っていません。では、こちらの入口で並び直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 器に未接触と答え注文入口で並び直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't touched any bowls yet. I'll join the queue again at this entrance, then.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have not touched the bowls and will line up again at the ordering entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 列では、先にうどんの種類をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: In the queue, please tell us your udon choice first.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 温かいうどんを一つお願いします。初めてなので、受け取りまでの進み方も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の温うどんを注文し受取までの進み方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: One hot udon, please. It's my first time, so could you also explain how to proceed until I collect it?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Order your hot udon and ask how to proceed to collection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お連れの方も、ご注文されますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人は入口でメニューを見ています。私の分だけ先にお願いします。友人にはこの列へ来るよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人は選択中なので自分の分を先に頼み列を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: My friend is looking at the menu by the entrance. Please take just my order first. I'll tell my friend to come to this queue.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Order yours first while your friend chooses and tell them about the queue. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まず、お客様の一つを伺います。受取の場所はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll take your one order first. The collection point is here.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ここで受け取るんですね。友人の注文を待つ間は、どちらで待てば通行の邪魔になりませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受取場所を確認し友人を待つ場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: So I collect it here. While waiting for my friend's order, where should I wait so I won't obstruct people passing?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the collection point and ask where to wait for your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 受け取りが済んだら、空いている席でお待ちください。お連れの方も決まりましたらこちらへどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: After collecting your food, please wait at an available seat. Your companion can come here once they've decided too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 差出し前のご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice before mailing something?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 窓付きの封筒に宛名の紙を入れました。最初は見えましたが、持ち上げると下へずれて名前が隠れます。まだ封はしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 窓封筒で宛名紙がずれ隠れる未封状態を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I put the address sheet in a window envelope. It was visible at first, but when I lift it, the sheet slides down and hides the name. I haven't sealed it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the address sheet shifts out of view in an unsealed window envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 封筒を置いた時だけでなく、用紙が動いた時の表示も見てみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the display not just with the envelope lying down, but when the paper moves too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 置いたときは見えますが、立てると名前と住所の一部が隠れます。こんなふうに動きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 置くと読めるが立てると隠れる動きを実物で示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's visible when lying down, but standing it up hides the name and part of the address. It moves like this.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Demonstrate that the address is readable lying down but hidden when the envelope stands upright. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今回使う宛名が見える準備を、封をする前に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Before sealing it, please check that the address you're using will stay visible.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 折り方を変えてみます。宛名を外に書き直す方法にする場合も、先に確認してから準備したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 折り方を見直し別の宛名記入方法も準備前に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll try changing how it's folded. If I switch to writing the address on the outside, I'd like to check that first before preparing it too.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reconsider the fold and consult before preparing a different way of writing the address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 中へ入れる書類は、もうそろっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you gathered all the documents going inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 書類は三枚です。今は宛名の紙だけで試したので、三枚を入れてからもう一度確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 三枚の書類をまだ入れておらず実際の全封入物で再確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: There are three sheets. So far I've tested only the address sheet, so I'll put all three documents inside and check again.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the three documents have not been inserted yet and you will check with all the actual contents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 実際に入れる物をそろえて、表示を確認してからお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please gather everything that will actually go inside and check the address display before bringing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日はまだ封をせず持ち帰ります。三枚全部を入れて、持ち上げても宛名が見えるように準備してから戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未封で持ち帰り全書類を入れ動かしても読める状態に準備すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take it home unsealed today. I'll put all three sheets in and prepare it so the address stays visible even when lifted, then come back.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will take it home unsealed and prepare it with all documents so the address stays readable when moved. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。準備できたら、表示を一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-ASHIKAGA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Once it's ready, let's check the address display together.

DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 見学で何をご覧になりたいですか。
DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to see on your visit?

DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 去年の写真にいる牛を見たいです。あの牛は模様が似ていますが、同じ牛か分からないので教えてください。
DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨年写真と模様が似た牛の同一性を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to see the cow in last year's photo. That one has similar markings, but I don't know if it's the same cow. Could you tell me?
DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the cow with markings similar to last year's photo is the same animal. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真に、耳の札の番号は写っていますか。
DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does the photo show the number on its ear tag?

DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 番号は一部だけ写っています。拡大しても残りが読めないので、写真を見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 耳標番号が一部しか読めず写真の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only part of the number is visible. I can't read the rest even when enlarging it, so could you look at the photo?
DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say only part of the ear-tag number is readable and ask them to check the photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今の見学対象を担当へ確認します。柵の内側へ入って札を読もうとしないでください。
DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check with the person in charge which cows are available to view now. Please don't enter the enclosure to try to read a tag.

DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。柵の外で待ちます。読める数字はここですので、担当の方にも見せます。
DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 柵外で待ち写真の読める数字を担当へ示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I'll wait outside the fence. These are the digits I can read, so I'll show the person in charge too.
DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Wait outside the fence and show the readable digits in the photo to the person in charge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真はいつ、どこで撮った物ですか。
DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-07.translation: When and where was the photo taken?

DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 去年の六月に、ここで撮りました。そのとき案内をしてくれた方の名前は覚えていません。
DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 撮影時期と場所を答え当時の案内者名は覚えていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here, in June last year. I don't remember the name of the person who showed us around then.
DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the photo's time and location and say you do not remember the guide's name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。担当から現在の見学対象をご案内します。
DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. The person in charge will explain which cows you can view now.

DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 写真の時期と番号を伝えます。同じ牛か分からなければ、今日見られる牛について教えていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 照合情報を伝え同一個体不明なら現在の見学案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll give them the photo date and number. If we can't tell whether it's the same cow, I'd like to hear about the cows we can see today.
DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Provide the matching information and request guidance on the current visit if the animal cannot be identified. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらで担当の案内をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please wait here for the person in charge's guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 本日のご利用は十八時までです。お帰りの準備をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.translation: Today's use ends at six p.m. Please get ready to leave.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.sourceJa: もうそんな時間なんですね。友人が休憩室で寝ています。起こして準備しますが、荷物をまとめる場所も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.hintJa: 利用終了に気づき友人を起こして荷物をまとめる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.translation: I hadn't realized it was so late. My friend is asleep in the rest room. I'll wake them and get ready, but could you also tell me where we can gather our things?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.hintTranslation: Realize the closing time, say you will wake your friend, and ask where to pack your belongings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 通路を空けて、こちらでおまとめください。お荷物は全部休憩室にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.translation: Please gather them here while keeping the passage clear. Are all your belongings in the rest room?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 上着だけロッカーに残しています。友人を起こしてから、私が取りに行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.hintJa: 上着がロッカーにあり友人を起こした後取りに行くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.translation: Only my jacket is still in the locker. After waking my friend, I'll go and get it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.hintTranslation: Say your jacket is in the locker and you will fetch it after waking your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 退出前にロッカーも確認してください。この後はお帰りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.translation: Please check your locker before leaving too. Are you going home after this?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 今日は別の宿に泊まります。そこへの到着が遅れそうなので、出る前に連絡したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.hintJa: 別宿への到着が遅れるため退出前に連絡したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.translation: We're staying at another lodging tonight. We may arrive there late, so I'd like to contact them before leaving.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.hintTranslation: Say you want to contact your other lodging before departure because you may arrive late. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.sourceJa: ご連絡の間は、入口の通行を妨げない所でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.translation: While contacting them, please stay somewhere that doesn't obstruct the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 分かりました。友人が荷物をまとめる間に電話します。忘れ物があった場合の連絡先も教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.hintJa: 通行を避けて電話し忘れ物の問い合わせ先を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.translation: Understood. I'll call while my friend packs. Could you also give me the contact details for lost-property inquiries?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.hintTranslation: Call without blocking the passage and ask for the lost-property contact. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 受付の連絡先をご案内します。まず、お荷物とロッカーを確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.translation: I'll give you reception's contact details. First, please check your belongings and locker.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。友人と持ち物を確認して出ます。鍵の返却もこちらでいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.hintJa: 二人で持ち物を確認して退出し鍵の返却先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.translation: Thank you. My friend and I will check our things before leaving. Should we return the key here too?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.hintTranslation: Say you will both check your belongings before leaving and ask where to return the key. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 受付で確認しますので、鍵を持ってお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-02-001-SHARE.translation: We'll check at reception, so please come with the key.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.sourceJa: ご予約の確認をいたしましょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 写真にテントがあったので、用意されていると思って来ました。予約には区画とあります。テントも付いているか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.hintJa: 区画予約に写真のテント貸出しも含むか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.translation: There was a tent in the photo, so I came thinking it would be provided. My reservation says ‘pitch.’ I'd like to check whether a tent is included too.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.hintTranslation: Ask whether a pitch reservation includes rental of the tent shown in the photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.sourceJa: こちらの予約は場所の区画です。写真は設営例で、テントの貸出し申込みではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.translation: This reservation is for a space only. The photo shows an example setup; it isn't a tent-rental booking.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.sourceJa: テントは持ってきていません。寝袋しかないので、このままでは準備が足りません。今から借りられるものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.hintJa: 自前テントなしで寝袋のみと説明し今からの貸出を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.translation: I haven't brought a tent. I only have a sleeping bag, so I'm not properly equipped as it stands. Is there anything I can rent now?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.hintTranslation: Explain that you have only a sleeping bag and no tent, and ask about rentals available now. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 貸出しを希望される場合は、在庫と条件を担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.translation: If you'd like to rent equipment, we'll check stock and conditions with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.sourceJa: お願いします。借りられる物の内容と料金も聞いてから、友人と相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.hintJa: 貸出内容と料金を確認後に友人と相談したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.translation: Please. I'd like to hear what can be rented and the fees before discussing it with my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.hintTranslation: Ask to check the rental contents and price before consulting your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.sourceJa: お連れの方は、もう区画で準備を始めていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.translation: Has your companion already started setting up at the pitch?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 区画には荷物を置いただけです。友人にも、受付で確認が済むまで待ってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.hintJa: 同行者は荷物を置いたのみで受付確認まで待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.translation: We've only put our bags on the pitch. I'll ask my friend to wait until we've finished checking at reception too.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.hintTranslation: Say your companion has only put down the luggage and will wait until reception confirms things. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 貸出しができなければ、どうされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.translation: What will you do if rental isn't possible?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 借りられなければ、今日は別の宿を探します。区画の予約をどうするかも相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.hintJa: 貸出不可なら別宿を探す予定を伝え区画予約の扱いも相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.translation: If we can't rent equipment, we'll look for another place to stay tonight. Could we also discuss what to do about the pitch reservation?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.hintTranslation: Explain that you will seek other lodging if rental is unavailable and ask about handling the pitch reservation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 承知しました。装備の貸出しと、ご予約の扱いを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-03-001-SHARE.translation: Understood. I'll check both equipment rental and how to handle your reservation.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 点検で変わったことはありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.translation: Did you find anything unusual during the inspection?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 入口側の黄色い板に、小さい点が三つあります。虫か汚れか私には分からないので、記録する前に見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.hintJa: 三つの点が虫か汚れか不明と報告し記録前の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.translation: There are three small dots on the yellow board near the entrance. I can't tell whether they're insects or dirt. Could you look before I record them?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.hintTranslation: Report three dots of uncertain identity, insects or dirt, and ask for checking before recording them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 板には触っていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.translation: You haven't touched the board, have you?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 触っていません。写真は撮りましたが、影になっていて形がはっきり写りませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.hintJa: 板は未接触で写真も影で不鮮明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.translation: No. I took a photo, but it's in shadow, so the shapes aren't clear in it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not touched the board and the photo is unclear because of shadow. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 現地で確認しましょう。いつ見つけましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.translation: Let's check it on site. When did you find them?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 今、十時の点検で見つけました。昨日の記録には書いてありませんが、私が昨日見たわけではないので、いつ付いたかは不明です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.hintJa: 発見時刻を伝え昨日は自身で見ておらず付着時期不明と話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.translation: Just now, during the ten-o'clock inspection. They aren't in yesterday's record, but I didn't inspect it myself yesterday, so I don't know when they appeared.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.hintTranslation: Give the discovery time and explain that you did not see it yourself yesterday and do not know when the dots appeared. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 分かりました。記録には時刻と場所を先に残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.translation: Understood. Please record the time and location first.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 入口側、十時と書きます。数の欄は確認が済んでから記入したいので、空欄のままでいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.hintJa: 時刻場所を記録し未確定の数欄の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.translation: I'll write ‘entrance side, ten o'clock.’ I'd like to enter the number after checking is finished, so may I leave that field blank?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.hintTranslation: Record the time and place and ask what to do with the unconfirmed number field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 確認中と分かるように記しておいてください。ほかの板は確認しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.translation: Please mark it clearly as being checked. Have you checked the other boards?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 奥の板はまだです。こちらの確認中と記したら、次の板を見ます。種類の分からない物があれば、同じように報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.hintJa: 確認中を記した後に未点検の奥を確認し不明物は報告すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.translation: Not the board at the back yet. Once I've marked this as being checked, I'll look at the next board. If I find anything I can't identify, I'll report it the same way.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.hintTranslation: Say you will mark the current item as being checked, inspect the unexamined board at the back, and report unknown items. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.sourceJa: お願いします。入口側の板は一緒に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-04-001-SHARE.translation: Please do. We'll check the entrance-side board together.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 布はどのくらいご入用ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.translation: How much fabric do you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.sourceJa: この鳥の柄を一つ使いたいです。柄が途中で切れないように買うなら、どこからどのくらい必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.hintJa: 鳥の柄を切らず使える購入長さと切る位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.translation: I'd like to use one of these bird motifs. To buy enough without cutting the design off, where should the cut start and how much do I need?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.hintTranslation: Ask what length and cutting position will let you use a whole bird motif. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.sourceJa: この柄は六十センチごとに繰り返します。端が柄の途中なので、今の端から六十センチだけでは一つが途中になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.translation: This pattern repeats every sixty centimeters. The edge is partway through a motif, so just sixty centimeters from the current edge would leave a motif cut off.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 今の端から六十センチだと、鳥が全部入りませんね。切る場所を見ながら決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.hintJa: 今の端からの長さでは柄が切れると理解し切る位置も見たいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.translation: So sixty centimeters from the current edge won't include a whole bird. I'd like to decide while looking at the cutting positions too.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.hintTranslation: Understand that a length measured from the current edge cuts off the motif and say you want to see the cutting positions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.sourceJa: どの柄を中心にしたいか、ご覧ください。切る長さは、それから確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.translation: Please look at which motif you want in the center. We'll check the cutting length after that.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.sourceJa: この鳥を中心にします。縫う余白も必要ですが、まだ長さを決めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.hintJa: 中心にしたい柄を示し縫い余白も必要だが長さ未定と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.translation: I'd like this bird in the center. I also need seam allowance, but I haven't decided on the length yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.hintTranslation: Show the motif you want centered and explain that you need seam allowance but have not settled the length. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 必要な余白の長さは、ご自分の型紙で確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.translation: Can you check the required allowance against your own paper pattern?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 型紙は家です。今日は布を切ってもらわず、柄の大きさと繰返しをメモして型紙と比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.hintJa: 型紙不在で今日は切らず柄寸法を記録すると選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.translation: The pattern is at home. I won't have the fabric cut today; I'd like to note the motif size and repeat and compare them with the pattern.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.hintTranslation: Choose not to have fabric cut today because you do not have the paper pattern, and note the motif dimensions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.sourceJa: こちらの見本で、柄の位置をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.translation: Please check the motif positions on this sample.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 鳥の位置と六十センチの繰返しをメモしました。型紙を持ってもう一度来たいので、この布の商品番号も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.hintJa: 柄情報を控え型紙持参で再来店するため商品番号を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.translation: I've noted the bird's position and the sixty-centimeter repeat. I'd like to come back with my pattern, so could you also give me this fabric's product number?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.hintTranslation: Note the motif information and ask for the product number so you can return with your paper pattern. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.sourceJa: こちらの商品番号です。次回、型紙と合わせて長さをご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-05-001-SHARE.translation: Here is the product number. Next time, please discuss the length with us using your paper pattern.
